ideas.pitch: An AI-powered community coordination platform that connects elderly residents in Newark with student volunteer drivers for grocery runs and medical appointments, optimizing group outings to minimize isolation.
ideas.title: Newark Senior Connect
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the winning formula of Outreach by focusing on clear, measurable social impact and solving a localized community problem that local judges will immediately care about.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite and aerial imagery monitoring tool designed for university campuses and local municipalities in New Jersey to track green space conservation and waste management compliance.
ideas.title: CampusGreen Compliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes complex spatial data analysis and machine learning in a lightweight web dashboard, following the proven trajectory of GeoNex-ATLAS.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-localized AI nutrition assistant tailored to students and low-income residents in Newark, suggesting healthy meal plans based on real-time inventory and sales at nearby local grocery stores and bodegas.
ideas.title: NutriNewark
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on the E-Foodiee win by adding localized economic utility—solving food desert navigation in the host city.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous micro-task marketplace for university students featuring instant escrow settlements via stablecoins on Base, eliminating peer-to-peer payment friction for campus services.
ideas.title: MicroEscrow Campus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the Dispatch win by integrating blockchain transaction primitives into a practical consumer marketplace application.

ideas.pitch: An explainable graph intelligence dashboard that visualizes local small business scam vulnerabilities and AML risks using lightweight localized transaction and permit data.
ideas.title: RiskRadar Newark
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases genuinely hard engineering by combining graph intelligence and explainable analytics, echoing the winning strategy of Bito.
